title: Zachary J NDE 2124
content: I was hit by the car; headlights blinded me as it felt like someone shoved me into the street. A bird fluttered by, catching my attention. A gray-blue, translucent Raven. I stared at it for a moment, realizing I was floating. I saw to one side of me a great hole, which seemed to absorb all light, a space of pure nothing, and opposite it a hole of pure light, I was between the two. The Raven circled, letting out an unworldly cry, and flew lower. I saw - things. They're hard to describe. It's like catching a glimpse of a monster out of the corner of your eye, and turning to see there's nothing there - seeing someone other than you in the mirror, blinking, and they're gone. They were the beasts that were at all places in space and time, yet we could not see them, and they could not see us. I noticed one, and at the same time, it noticed me. I was scared, and curled up, floating alone as more of those things noticed me. They began to come towards me, almost running, making terrible sounds. I held my arm out for some reason; it just seemed the right thing to do. The Raven landed on my arm, and gave off a loud caw, which seemed to chase the beasts off. I woke up in a hospital bed. For days after that I noticed glimmers of disturbing things like the things. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 11/23/91 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Accident Hit by car Life threatening event, but not clinical death Was hit by a car. How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? Uncertain I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I felt and knew all there was to feel and know in that instant, and then it was gone. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When the raven landed on my arm. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster than usual Two bits of Space Time were clearly overlapping where they should've been. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could see things that normal people couldn't see. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain It could've been a tunnel; all I could see was the White, Black, and Grey of the Lights. Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes They were clearly sinister in intent charging at me, and the raven was protecting me. I used to read Poe's 'The Raven' a lot, and had a pet raven at one point, but not like this one. The raven had a single feather pointing up and back at the back of his head. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Two large Lights, one good, one evil. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Neither Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate None Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Moderate None Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I lost it, as the raven left contact with me. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I could see certain things for a little while afterward - I still get glimpses. Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I had no choice but to believe. It was all I had. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I still believe. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reported realizing he was "floating" and "lost awareness of my body."

arrival.other_being_detail: A "gray-blue, translucent Raven" that landed on his arm; also "beasts" described as sinister entities that noticed him and charged toward him until the raven's caw chased them off.

environment.environment_other_detail: He perceived two opposing "holes": one that "seemed to absorb all light, a space of pure nothing" and opposite it a "hole of pure light"; he was "between the two" with "White, Black, and Grey".

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: None (reported as moderate none before and after).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Sinister "beasts" perceived and a protective translucent raven; two opposing "Lights"/voids (pure nothing vs pure light).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He described floating and perceiving two opposing holes (pure nothing/pure light) while seeing entities and a raven; he then woke in a hospital bed.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He reported overlapping "Space Time" and simultaneously perceiving the raven, the beasts, and the opposing light/void.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A "gray-blue, translucent Raven" with a single feather pointing up/back protected him by cawing, which "seemed to chase the beasts off." He described entities "at all places in space and time" that normally cannot be seen.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I saw to one side of me a great hole, which seemed to absorb all light, a space of pure nothing, and opposite it a hole of pure light, I was between the two."
